steps.content: [Background - Dining Car]
The dining car is brightly lit. Silver cutlery clinks against porcelain plates, producing crisp yet gentle sounds.

The air carries the scent of butter and vanilla. Braised beef in red wine sauce, roasted lamb chops, smoked cod, cream soup... fine dishes arrive at the tables one after another. A dessert cart rolls slowly down the aisle, the puddings and lemon tarts on it glistening under the lights.
It's the kind of experience that could make anyone forget their troubles, if only for a moment... Unfortunately, you're in no mood to enjoy anything like that right now.
Right now, you're sitting in the corner of the dining car with Clementine, pretending to read a newspaper while discreetly observing the other diners.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: The corridor was spotless. Nothing worth noting.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: I see... Looks like we'll have to focus on the passengers after all...

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: Most of the first-class passengers are here. But people don't typically invite strangers into their rooms, so getting into their compartments for a proper search will be difficult. We'll need to come up with another approach.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: Mmm... What should we do then...

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: ...You can finish eating before you answer me.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: Oh dear, how unsightly of me... Mmm, my, it's delicious!
Clementine swallows the last bite of the fish and dabs the corners of her mouth with her napkin in slow, deliberate movements. Every motion is perfect and refined.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: The smoked fish here is excellent. You really should try some.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: Let's talk business first. Did you find anything?

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: Of course. The Praeva is an old train, so there are only <color=#fb9259>3</color> first-class passengers besides us. That little attendant Allison is quite the gossip. I barely had to ask before she told me everything—
Clementine leans in close, ducking behind the newspaper just as you did. She lowers her voice, her finger sliding across the table's edge to point toward another corner in secret.
[William's portrait appears, his hat pulled low]
The man is sitting alone in the corner, his back to the night beyond the window. His jawline is rough, his brow sits low, and the entire upper half of his face is lost beneath the shadow of his hat.

His sleeves are rolled up, revealing his muscular forearms. His knuckles are rough and broad—with your trained eyes, you can immediately tell that these are the hands of someone accustomed to hard labor.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: The occupant of Room 102, <color=#fb9259>William "Rusty Nail"</color>. That's his street name, by the way. As you can probably tell, his personality is just as rough around the edges as his appearance.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: Word is he's gone straight now, but back in the day, he was tangled up with the gangs on the west side—debt collection, smuggling, you name it. Apparently, he even has blood on his hands...!
William turns his head slightly, and his sharp eyes sweep toward you. Could he have sensed your gaze? You and Clementine immediately duck behind your newspapers.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: Phew, that was close...

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: In any case, this is an exceptionally dangerous individual. If anyone on this train is connected to a crime, he's our prime suspect.

You continue observing William from behind your newspaper. His eyes are constantly scanning the entire dining car with extreme wariness as he sits in his corner. He looks ready to spring into action at the slightest provocation—a dangerous and suspicious individual, just as Clementine said.
Clementine's finger casually traces a circle in the air before pointing to the next suspect.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Old Mary Jones</color> is in Room 103. She lived an unremarkable life through her middle age, but then suddenly came into wealth in her later years. It's said that she received a massive settlement out of nowhere.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: That said, her hearing and mind aren't what they used to be. She seems to have suffered some kind of trauma, and keeps mistaking people for her own children...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Oh, is that you, little Annie? That's strange, shouldn't you be at school? What are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Attendant Allison
steps.content: Mrs. Jones... you've mistaken me for someone else again...
The white-haired old woman pulls the attendant along, examining her closely, and insists that she's absolutely the child from her family who should be at school—little Annie.
You observe her closely. The old woman's clothing is neat and clean, and in her handbag are several unfinished knitted sweaters in various colors... She must have more than one child.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: "Seventy-Year-Old Woman Boards Train, Commits Bizarre Crime"... Hey, that would make for quite an interesting story, wouldn't it?

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: That'd be bizarre, alright.
And... a massive settlement that came out of nowhere? That's certainly worth investigating.
You review the first-class cabin numbers in your head. There are four cabins in total, and there are three suspects so far... so one person remains unaccounted for.
You peek out from behind the newspaper, only to unexpectedly lock eyes with someone.

steps.speaker: Man & ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh.
The man freezes for a moment. Then, he closes the menu in his hand, stands up, and walks toward your table.
You instinctively sit up straight and put on the vacant expression you've perfected over the years, attempting to fade into the background. Yet, the footsteps still stop right beside you.
The man stops beside the table, but he doesn't look at you.

steps.speaker: Man with Glasses
steps.content: Fancy seeing you here. It's been a while, Clementine.

Seeing him up close, you notice that his complexion is rather pale, and there are prominent dark circles beneath his eyes. His gaze shifts constantly behind his glasses, perhaps to check the reactions of those around him. Although he's wearing a smile, you can't help but think it feels forced.

steps.speaker: Man with Glasses
steps.content: I don't believe we've met. Is this gentleman your companion?

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.content: A pleasure to meet you. My name is <color=#fb9259>Carl</color>, and I'm staying in first-class cabin 101. I'm in the trading business, so I happen to have some ties with Clementine's family.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: Detective ${PlayerName}. I was invited by Ms. Clementine to help her resolve a small matter.
You don't specify what the case entails, yet you notice a subtle change in his expression, almost as if... he realized something.

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.content: Oh... I see. <color=#fb9259>So you're the one she chose this time</color>.

steps.speaker: Detective %u
steps.content: ...What do you mean?
A sharp sound cuts through the conversation. Someone slams a glass down on the table.

steps.speaker: Clementine
steps.content: Just say what you came to say. Otherwise, get out. I have nothing to discuss with you.

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.content: There's no need to be so tense. I only came to say hello. I'll be on my way soon enough. After all, I wouldn't want to spoil your mood.

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.content: Still... to be chosen as her companion... Hehe, I'm not sure if I should call you lucky, or unlucky.
Carl turns to leave. As he passes by you, he pauses briefly.

steps.speaker: Carl
steps.content: Farewell, detective. Good luck to you.
The man puts his hat back on, tips it in a polite nod, then swiftly exits the dining car.

The chatter of other diners quickly fills the silence. You don't reach for the newspaper. Clementine seems to be complaining about something, but you're too preoccupied with the flood of doubts that is washing over your mind.
The one she chose this time...? What did he mean by that?
[Battle 3, Train Scene]
